overview: Based on the published agenda, the Kronenwetter Plan Commission was scheduled to meet on September 21, 2026, to address a land division request, review conditional use permit status for a Marathon County facility, and consider amendments to a preliminary plat recommendation for Green Tree Trails Subdivision. The meeting was also set to include an update on ongoing zoning and subdivision ordinance review.

agenda.item: Certified Survey Map - Land Division Request by Shaina Daris, 2172 Wood Rd
Conditional Use Permit - Marathon County Facility - Highway Garage
Green Tree Trails Subdivision Preliminary Plat - Rescind or Amend Prior Recommendation
Next Steps in Ongoing Review of Zoning and Subdivision Ordinances

discussions.item: Certified Survey Map - Land Division Request by Shaina Daris
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to consider a land division request by Shaina Daris involving properties at 2172 Wood Rd and 2208 Tracy Ct in the Glen Arbor development. The proposed Certified Survey Map would change the boundary between the two parcels, with properties identified as Glen Arbor Lot 8 and Glen Arbor Lot 1 located in the N1/2 SW FRL1/4 of Section 7, T27N, R8E.

discussions.item: Conditional Use Permit - Marathon County Facility - Highway Garage
discussions.body: The Commission was set to continue discussion on a conditional use permit application for a Marathon County facility highway garage. The agenda indicated this was old business, suggesting prior consideration of this application.

discussions.item: Green Tree Trails Subdivision Preliminary Plat
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to review the Green Tree Trails Subdivision preliminary plat application and consider whether to rescind or amend a prior recommendation. This item was listed as old business requiring possible action.
The Commission was expected to discuss next steps in an ongoing comprehensive review of the Village's zoning and subdivision ordinances. This item indicated continuing work on regulatory updates.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with three minutes per person, with time extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on or approve the Certified Survey Map land division request by Shaina Daris
Expected to take action on the Conditional Use Permit for Marathon County Highway Garage
Scheduled to consider rescinding or amending the prior recommendation on Green Tree Trails Subdivision preliminary plat
Expected to determine next steps in zoning and subdivision ordinance review
title: Plan Commission Meeting - 2026-09-21
